svg.title: Native Rust Magnitude Adapter, MCPMark CoW CRUD, FreeToken-Beat BA-AirMoL & 138 Proofs
svg.desc: Four-panel summary of Claims LA-72 through LA-75 and 138 six-kernel Lean 4.36.0 theorems (1502 Linux bwrap fleet): (A) Zero-Python native Rust mol-magnitude-adapter fronting Magnitude 0.3.5 (Seismic) on CogLoadBench 4x extraneous context pollution across Apple M5 Max, NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor (physical TI INA238 DC shunt measured_j), and AMD Zen 5 RAPL; (B) 24-workflow (72-call) stateful MCPMark multi-turn CRUD sandbox (0.00% live state corruption via Copy-on-Write LUT6 guard) plus Bandwidth-Adaptive BA-Tiered-Expert-AirMoL vs FreeToken (UC Berkeley Aug 2026) and KTransformers; (C) 144/144 Yosys abc -lut 6 Boolean miter and Cross-Silicon Window 24 Thor DC shunt telemetry (3.330x); and (D) Exact 64 KB watch SRAM 14-bank partition, 106.97 MHz XC7A200T openXC7 gateware, 15.16 KB 19-export lut6_core.wasm, and 138 six-kernel theorems (1502 fleet).
